Which value source produced a statement cell (one node in one period).

The evaluator resolves every unmasked cell by the precedence
`Value > Forecast > Formula`. The selected source is recorded on the cell,
including when that source's result is unavailable.

Sign with which the component enters the formula: `"+"` or `"-"`.

Constant compound growth; base and target must be non-zero with the same sign.

ForecastSpec.description:
A forecast method with its typed parameters.

Serializes as `{ "method": ..., "params": { ... } }`. `params` may be
omitted when the method needs none.

oneOf.description: Carry the last value forward.
Compound one growth rate per period.
Compound a different growth rate each period.
Sample an additive random walk.
Sample a multiplicative random walk for positive values.
Set exact values for chosen periods, carrying forward between them.
Project from a historical series.
Project a repeating pattern from a historical series.
Sample a mean-reverting AR(1) process.
Resample changes from a historical series.
Glide toward a target level over the forecast horizon.

ForecastTrendMethod.description: Trend model of a time-series forecast.

oneOf.description: Least-squares linear trend.
Holt exponential smoothing; requires `alpha` and `beta`.
Moving average; requires `window`.

NodeType.description:
Node computation type.

Determines how a node's value is computed:
- **Value**: Only explicit values (actuals, assumptions)
- **Calculated**: Only formula-derived
- **Mixed**: Value OR Forecast OR Formula (precedence: Value > Forecast > Formula)

A non-finite value, written as its sentinel string.

NonFiniteF64Wire.description:
An `f64` in the [`non_finite_f64`] wire form: a JSON number when finite,
otherwise one of the strings `"inf"`, `"-inf"` or `"nan"`.

Contract types store plain `f64` fields with
`#[serde(with = "finstack_quant_core::wire::non_finite_f64")]` and name this
type in `#[schemars(with = ...)]`, so the generated schema describes the
sentinel strings the serializer actually writes.

NonFiniteSentinel.description: Sentinel string the [`non_finite_f64`] adapter writes for a non-finite `f64`.

oneOf.description: `+∞`, written as `"inf"`.

`FY2025W53`.

description: Detailed explanation of a node's calculation.

breakdown.description:
Components of the formula with the values they resolved to in this
period, including `cs.<component>.<instrument_or_total>`
capital-structure references.

Populated only when the formula produced the value (`source` is
`formula`, or unknown). Empty when `source` is `value` or
`forecast`: the formula was not evaluated, and `source` /
`forecast` describe where the value came from. When the formula is a
pure sum/difference of references there is one step per term, in
formula order, each with `operation` `"+"` or `"-"`, and the signed
values sum to `final_value`. For any other formula each referenced
component is listed once with `operation` unset.

final_value.description:
Final calculated value; non-finite values serialize as `"nan"`,
`"inf"` or `"-inf"`.

forecast.description:
The node's forecast specification (method and parameters) when
`source` is `forecast`; `None` for every other source.

formula_text.description:
Formula text (if calculated). Present whenever the node has a
formula, including when `source` shows that an explicit value or a
forecast took precedence over it.

source.description:
Value source selected for the cell under the
`Value > Forecast > Formula` precedence: `value` (the explicit value
stored on the node), `forecast` or `formula`.

Read from the result cell; `None` when no source was selected (a
masked or missing cell, or one left unavailable before a source was
chosen) and for hand-built results.
